note: Export side is solidly confirmed by dated Indian customs export records from Kolkata Sea to Switzerland, France, South Korea, Thailand and Germany in Feb 2026, all under HS 42032910 (leather industrial gloves) — this matches the declared HS 420329 and confirms the company is an actual shipper, not merely a claimant. Declared second HS 611610 (impregnated/coated textile gloves) was not observed in the visible rows; only 42032910 appeared, so the 611610 part of the declared range is unverified rather than contradicted. Industry label 'Продукты питания и FMCG' (food/FMCG) is clearly wrong for this company — the shipment descriptions are machine-made industrial leather gloves (PPE/hand protection), so the industry field should be corrected to leather goods / personal protective equipment; per project rules this is a data correction, not a rejection ground. Role: manufacturer (own factory address in Kolkata, goods described as machine-made industrial leather gloves with RODTEP claim, LUT No AD1903250242673 and AEO certificate INAABCV1885C2F256 quoted in the shipment text, which is consistent with a manufacturer-exporter). Revenue and export volume figures: null — no public figure obtained, not estimated. Sanctions/litigation: not assessed in this role and not a rejection ground per project rules. Verdict: accepted, HS 420329 confirmed by customs records, HS 611610 unverified, industry corrected, domestic supply evidence outstanding.
